scope: Public global I_id on the complete viable population using a single RandomState(0) stream. Independent sequence-substitution and random-index oracle; this is NOT the paper RNG policy or a printed target.
preprocessing: Retain all 28,530 genotypes with Fit > 0.5, including 3,903 isolates; preserve source row order; use ln(Fit/0.5). Match positions 1..69 and every ordered A/C/G/T allele pair. Draw n random pairs with replacement using one RandomState(0) stream without reseeding, ddof=0; mean and population SD/sqrt(828).

sources.locator: Results, Epistasis is highly idiosyncratic, p. 1686 (PDF page 2): I_id=0.612 +/- 0.005 s.e.m.; Methods, Estimating the idiosyncrasy index, p. 1692 (PDF page 8).

Methods, Estimating the idiosyncrasy index. The general matched-size definition is used with an explicitly chosen validation seed 0; expected value independently reconstructed on 2026-10-02, not taken from GraphFLA.

comparison.justification: Floating-point agreement on fixed input and a fixed RNG stream; not a tolerance fitted to a printed-paper value.
